title: Pradhan
desc: When an honest policeman is transferred to Dharmapur, he encounters widespread corruption and fights to stay true to his principles.

title: Kamalar Banabas
desc: Banished from the kingdom under false pretences, Kamala endures hardship while raising her son, determined to clear her name and reunite with her loved ones.

title: Praner Cheye Priyo
desc: A couple's life falls to ruin when Chaiti, a sinister woman, marries into their family and wreaks havoc among them.

title: Satya Mithya
desc: Worried to see his daughter Rita in low spirits, Mr Chowdhury decides to take her to Dhaka. There, he hires Raju, a responsible young man, whom Rita falls in love with.

title: Aasroy
desc: Ankhu, after losing his wife, decides to marry another girl for the sake of his son, Sudhanshu. But things take a turn when Sudhanshu falls in love with Joysree, who is an orphan.
